svg:
How Document Control reviews a document and a new revision Review runs from Data Entry to Legal review to Managing Director sign-off, with a different person at each stage. A rejection or change request needs a reason, and the system records who decided and which version they saw. When a newer file is uploaded, the accepted version stays in use while the new revision goes through review; adopting it for the project is a separate decision. {% include diagrams/_style.html %}
1 · Review chain
Data Entry Prepares the record
Legal review Checks the content
MD sign-off Final approval A different person at each stage; an admin can’t sign by default. Rejections need a reason. Each decision records who and which version. 2 · A newer file arrives
Revision 1 · accepted Stays in use for the project
Revision 2 · in review Same review chain as above
Adopt for this project? A separate review decision
replaces it Unless revision 1 has expired or been revoked, nothing changes until then.
